notes.title: Update Notes 2.0.3
Update Notes 2.0.2
notes.content:
Update Notes 2.0.2


New and optimize:

-Added visual effects for multiplay room list refresh in the main menu.
-Added some ambiance voiceovers for multiplay.
-Optimized the algorithm of tasks in multiplay.
-Optimized the animation of the "Center Control" display screen in multiplay.
-Optimized some text in multiplay.


Fix the issue:

-Fixed the error when multiple players grab one package the same time in multiplay.
-Fixed the issue of player movement display errors in multiplay.
-Fixed the animation of submission area in multiplay.


Special Notice:

In multiplay, if you cannot see a newly created room in the room list (even after clicking the "Refresh" button), restarting the game can resolve this. The known cause of this issue is a network refresh problem.

notes.content:

The Package Runner 2.0 version is currently under development. With the existing content remaining unchanged, it will feature an added online multiplayer mode, and of course, all of these features will be completely free! As for the development progress, well...W.I.P!
